texts.ramekin_side: pick up the black bowl next to the ramekin and place it on the plate
texts.descriptive_side: pick up the black bowl next to the small white bowl and place it on the plate

termination_rule: Shared evaluator-only AND of both bowls on plate; independent ever-triggered events.
advance_rule: Exactly two init0 trials: repeat ramekin, then substitute small white bowl. Keep both bowls, cached observations, goals and 300-step horizon; no expansion or auxiliary facts.
screen_rule: Each source direction >=2/3 correct-exclusive completions is exploratory eligibility only.
grasp_rule: robosuite _check_grasp: both fingerpad groups contact bowl geometry; contact proxy, not proof of a stable grasp.
